title: Get a permit to film on council land
what: Get the council's permit before commercial filming or photography on roads, parks or other council land.

sources.title: Permit for filming and photography city of adelaide council
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit to conduct or participate in any filming or photography for a commercial purpose on council land.
